sentences.en: The government's anti-corruption tsar resigned yesterday following allegations of bribery.
sentences.zh: 1. 在有关受贿行为的指控之后，政府的反腐沙皇昨天辞职了。

sentences.en: Between you and me, he was dismissed for bribery.
sentences.zh: 2. 实不相瞒，他是因受贿而被解雇的。

sentences.en: His acceptance of the present was regarded as bribery.
sentences.zh: 3. 他接受礼物的行为被视为受贿。

phrases.zh: 1. 关于受贿的；涉及受贿的
